scope: Browser OBJ/MTL/PNG ZIP export and interactive GLB preview lighting

coverage: 26 unique normalized face, edge and corner lighting directions

deployed_browser.skipped_reason: Existing separately gated live edge upload check
deployed_browser.boundary: Synthetic session and API responses on the actual VM HTTPS origin using deployed static assets and real previously generated GLBs
coverage: Reparse OBJ with OBJLoader and MTL with MTLLoader
All material and texture references resolve inside the archive
UV v conversion matches source buffers
Top and bottom lighting produce different rendered pixels
Lighting changes do not refetch the model
Denied download reports a visible error and restores the export button
Existing catalog, tuning, upload error and gallery/chat/channel image handoff regressions

deployment.method: Source and hashed static assets copied after drift checks; index files replaced atomically
deployment.https_readiness: Both user and admin passed with certificate validation

limits: OBJ has no unit metadata; exports preserve original coordinates and world transforms.
Normal, roughness and metallic maps use MTL extensions with editor-dependent support. GLB preserves original PBR materials most faithfully.
OBJ text is bounded to 192 MiB; export memory use depends on model and browser.
No independent Blender/Maya/editor import or broad device/browser matrix was qualified.
Release gates remain 20 partial, 41 not run, zero fully passed.
